newsitem.title: USA: Edisto closes natgas marketing sale.
newsitem.headline: Edisto closes natgas marketing sale.

text.p: Edisto Resources Corp said Tuesday it has closed the previously announced sale of substantially all of the assets of its natural gas marketing operations to subsidiaries of Pacific Gas Transmission Co, subsidiary of Pacific Gas and Electric Co.

The sales price was $23.3 million in cash, plus the working capital of Energy Source at July 31, about $20 million. The sales price is subject to adjustment after the closing by the adjusted consolidated net income or loss of the operations from August 1 to November 30.

The sales price was reduced by about $5.3 million when two gas suppliers of Energy Source Canada, NESI Energy Marketing Canada and Tarpon Gas Marketing, sought protection from creditors under Canadian bankruptcy law, Edisto noted.
